title: Finiteness of Newtonian equilibrium points
exact_target: Must finitely many positive point charges in three-dimensional space have only finitely many equilibrium points, even for nongeneric configurations?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3700035 (AMR-036-0035). CC BY 4.0.
Herbert Edelsbrunner, Christopher Fillmore and Gonçalo Oliveira, Counting equilibria of the electrostatic potential (2025), §1, equation (1), Conjecture 1 and Result 1, pp.1–3.
